summary: WireGuard turned off while the shared link was bound to its address (192.168.2.2). The link stops answering; a direct connection over en0 works.

evidence.observation: After WireGuard On-Demand turned the tunnel off at home, utun7 vanished and three SSH connections (66258, 68957 and the stopped mux 79434) still held sockets from 192.168.2.2.
